severity.description: Gets the severity: error, warning or info.

path.description: Gets the location in the source document, using JSONPath for JSON input.

DocumentDiagnostic.description: A structural input or conversion diagnostic, separate from security findings.

originX.description: Gets or sets the x coordinate of the top-left origin of the laid-out region.

originY.description: Gets or sets the y coordinate of the top-left origin of the laid-out region.

layerSpacing.description: Gets or sets the horizontal gap between adjacent layers (columns).

nodeSpacing.description: Gets or sets the vertical gap between adjacent nodes within a layer.

maxWidth.description:
Gets or sets the width a row of columns may occupy before the next column wraps onto a new
row. The Microsoft Threat Modeling Tool's drawing surface is bounded and taller than it is
wide, so a wide model has to grow downwards; anything drawn past the right-hand limit is
clamped by the tool on load, which would pile elements on top of each other.

boundaryPadding.description: Gets or sets the padding between a trust boundary's edge and the members inside it.

boundaryHeaderHeight.description:
Gets or sets the extra headroom reserved at the top of a trust boundary for its title,
which is drawn inside the box and would otherwise print over the topmost member.

labelCharacterWidth.description:
Gets or sets the width one character of a data-flow label occupies. Labels are drawn as a
single unwrapped line, so this is what converts a flow's name into the space it needs.

labelHeight.description: Gets or sets the height of a data-flow label.

labelLaneSpacing.description: Gets or sets the perpendicular distance between adjacent label lanes.

labelLanes.description:
Gets or sets how many lanes either side of a connector a label may be pushed into before
the least-covered position is accepted. Larger values clear more labels at the cost of
bowing connectors further from a straight line.

LayoutOptions.description:
Tunable spacing parameters for DiagramLayout. Defaults produce a readable
layered diagram; callers may widen the gaps for larger stencils.

assumptions.description: Gets or sets the recorded assumptions.

externalDependencies.description: Gets or sets the external dependencies.

highLevelSystemDescription.description: Gets or sets the high-level system description.

owner.description: Gets or sets the model owner.

threatModelName.description: Gets or sets the threat model name.

MetaInformation.description: Free-text metadata describing the modeled system (owner, reviewer, assumptions, and so on).

id.description: Gets the stable pack identifier (for example, `azure`).

name.description: Gets the human-readable pack name shown in the palette.

count.description: Gets the number of stencils the pack contributes.

PackDto.description:
Describes a stencil pack: a named, togglable group of related stencils (for example, the
Azure pack). The palette uses packs so the user can show or hide whole families at once.

appliesTo.description: Gets the DFD primitive this property applies to (`process`, `datastore`, `external`, or `flow`).

name.description: Gets the property name, i.e. the custom-attribute key (for example, `AuthenticationScheme`).

kind.description: Gets the value kind that drives the editor control: `enum`, `bool`, or `string`.

values.description: Gets the allowed values for an `enum` or `bool` property; empty for a free-form `string`.

default.description: Gets the default value applied when the property is first added to an element.

PropertyDescriptor.description:
Typed definition of a single element custom property (for example, a data store's
`Encrypted` setting). The schema lets authoring surfaces render the right control
(dropdown, checkbox, or free text) and emit canonical values, so the analysis rules that
inspect these properties match reliably instead of guessing at free-form text.

id.description: Gets the stable stencil identifier (for example, `azure-sql`).

base.description: Gets the underlying DFD primitive this stencil maps to.

label.description: Gets the human-readable name shown in the palette.

category.description: Gets the palette grouping this stencil belongs to.

pack.description: Gets the stencil pack this stencil ships in (for example, `azure`).

blurb.description: Gets a short description of the stencil.

tags.description: Gets the free-form search tags and aliases for this stencil.

defaults.description: Gets the preset custom properties applied when the stencil is placed.

StencilDto.description:
Describes an authoring stencil: a named, categorized specialization of one of the four DFD
primitives (`process`, `datastore`, `external`, `boundary`). A stencil
maps to its string StencilDto.Base primitive for analysis, and its identity plus preset
properties enrich the model without requiring per-stencil rules.
